ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (white/light-gray) on the lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity pixels (black) concentrated in the central notch region and marginal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) zone extending from the peduncle through the median notch. The lateral lobes feature high-intensity (white) backgrounds populated with irregular, high-contrast black 'islands' and streaks, particularly dense near the trailing edge and lower margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, sharp V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 75-80 degrees relative to the horizontal midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of variations is highest near the distal tips, showing irregular jagged peaks and narrow valleys. The edge appears moderately worn with several small semi-circular indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a primarily concave trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, which terminate in sharp, upwardly curved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) across both white lateral fields. Notable density of these clusters in the mid-section of the right lobe and the lower-interior section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct black linear streaks visible on the right lobe white field, oriented roughly parallel to the fluke's leading edge, and several vertical rake-like marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Both distal tips exhibit bulbous, highly irregular pixel clusters with extreme high-frequency variations in intensity, corresponding to heavy barnacle colonization and associated structural irregularities.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark, bifurcated pigmentation mark resembles a 'wishbone' shape located in the lower-central region of the right lobe's white field.
